title: Learning Noise Optimization for Reward Alignment in Few-Step Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward alignment for diffusion- and flow-based generative models is often formulated over stochastic trajectories, making it less suitable for few-step deterministic generators. Initial noise optimization provides a trajectory-free alternative, but existing gradient-free methods require costly per-sample search at inference. We introduce LeNO (Learning Noise Optimization), which amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport while keeping the pretrained generator frozen. LeNO learns an anchor-conditioned distribution over noise corrections using Local GRPO and scalar rewards, eliminating iterative test-time optimization. For Gaussian initial noise with norm-preserving projection, we derive a tractable upper bound on the KL divergence between the corrected noise distribution and the original prior, providing a principled regularization objective. We evaluate LeNO on few-step text-to-image and protein

translated_title: 面向少步生成模型奖励对齐的学习式噪声优化
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流模型的奖励对齐通常是在随机轨迹上进行形式化的，这使得这类方法不太适用于少步确定性生成器。初始噪声优化提供了一种无需轨迹的替代方案，但现有的无梯度方法需要在推理阶段进行代价高昂的逐样本搜索。我们提出了LeNO（Learning Noise Optimization，学习式噪声优化），它将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为一个学习到的残差传输，同时保持预训练生成器完全冻结。LeNO利用局部GRPO和标量奖励，学习一个以锚点为条件的噪声修正分布，从而消除了迭代式的测试时优化。对于经过范数保持投影的高斯初始噪声，我们推导出了修正后噪声分布与原始先验之间KL散度的可求解上界，为该方法提供了一个有理论依据的正则化目标。我们在少步文本到图像和蛋白质生成任务上对LeNO进行了评估。
tldr: 提出LeNO方法，将奖励引导的初始噪声优化摊销为学习到的残差传输，在冻结预训练生成器的前提下实现少步生成模型的高效奖励对齐，并通过KL散度上界提供理论正则化。
en_tdlr: LeNO amortizes reward-guided initial noise optimization into a learned residual transport for frozen few-step generators, eliminating costly test-time search and providing principled KL-divergence-based regularization.
